mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, return_time, status FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY borrow_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, return_time, status FROM borrow_record WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY borrow_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record(user_id, book_id, due_time, status) VALUES(#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{dueTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 1, return_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, b.publisher AS publisher, b.stock AS stock, b.total AS total, COUNT(br.id) AS borrowCount FROM book b LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON b.id = br.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, b.stock, b.total ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT br.id, br.user_id, u.username, br.book_id, b.title, br.borrow_time, br.due_time, br.return_time, br.status FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id ORDER BY br.borrow_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status = 0 AND due_time < NOW()
